description: Announcement writer (email + Slack + FAQ) — Turn news into an announcement email, a short Slack post, a headline and up to 4 FAQs. Offline checks: what/why/when/action/questions coverage, effective-date weekday and US federal holiday check, days from today, reading ease and a 0-100 score. Params: news (required), audience (default employees), tone, date (YYYY-MM-DD effective date). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

news.description: e.g. Support hours move to 7am-7pm Central starting January 5 so customers in more time zones can reach us

name: ai_announcement
